name: memors-hooks
description: Hooks that run the memors-mcp knowledge-base loop for the agent — orient at session start, flag already-stored sources, nudge to record findings, and keep trust changes human-only

mcp_server.title: Start the memors MCP server
mcp_server.description: Start the bundled memors server (memors-mcp serve) for the project's knowledge base. Off by default: leave it off if you register memors yourself or only want the hooks

orient.title: Knowledge-base index at session start
orient.description: At session start and after /compact, add the knowledge base's index, search status and open lint count to the conversation

guard_cli.title: Block memors CLI writes from Bash
guard_cli.description: Deny Bash commands that change trust, write or forget through the memors-mcp CLI, or edit its database with sqlite3

check_known_source.title: Point at already-stored pages
check_known_source.description: After a web fetch, say when the URL is already in the knowledge base and where

nudge_remember.title: Remind to record findings
nudge_remember.description: Log web fetches and empty memors searches, and remind Claude once at the end of a turn when nothing was recorded

recall.title: Prompt recall
recall.description: On each prompt of 20 characters or more, add up to 3 keyword-matched knowledge-base addresses

index_bytes.title: Index size limit (bytes)
index_bytes.description: The largest index the session-start hook adds to the conversation
